card.name: Lambadao cuiabano
card.tagline: Fast peripheral couples lambadao of Cuiaba, Mato Grosso.
card.profile: Lambadao cuiabano (or simply lambadao) is a music-and-dance style characteristic of the Baixada Cuiabana in Mato Grosso, especially Cuiaba and Varzea Grande. A fast, swinging rhythm of the urban periphery with romantic or playful lyrics, it arrived via Para prospectors who brought lambada and synthesizes Para lambada with the local rasqueado heritage. Its first boom came in the 1990s (English Wikipedia; Prefeitura de Cuiaba).
card.insight: Often marginalized outside the periphery for its more sexualized versions, lambadao is nonetheless protected by municipal (Cuiaba) and Mato Grosso state cultural laws (Prefeitura de Cuiaba).
